sections.heading: Information
sections.text:
Capture The Flag is a Gamemode in which you must capture the enemies flag. Their flag is usually on the opposite side of the map from where you spawn.

You can use your Pet Button to pick up their flag, and you must make it back to your flag without losing their flag. Once you're back, you can use your pet button to score a point.

sections.heading: Striker (CTF Role)
sections.text:
- **Protect Your Flag!**

As the Striker, your mission is to capture the opposing team's flag.

Use the pet button near the enemy flag to pick it up. 

While carrying the flag, all players will see an arrow pointing to your location. 

Depending on the host's settings, you may get a boost/de-buff while carrying the flag, or even lose the ability to vent.

If the opposing team attacks you, you'll be transported back to your flag after a certain amount of time.

sections.heading: Information
sections.text:
Draft is a gamemode where players pick their roles before the game starts. Each player will be given a set amount of time to pick their role from a list of available roles. Once all players have picked their roles, the meeting will end and the game will start as normal.

When the game begins, a meeting will automatically be called. In this meeting, each player will receive a message with a number, their custom ID. Players will take turns choosing a role from a random selection of roles out of the list. 

When it's your turn to pick a role, you will be given a small selection of roles to choose from. You can vote for any player to change your selection. If you don't like the picked roles, there's always an extra option labeled "Random". This option picks any role that is still in the list and hasn't been picked yet. 

When you're satisfied with your selection, you can skip your vote to confirm it. If you don't pick a role in time, random will be picked automatically for you. The option you picked will be announced in chat. Everyone will know that this role was picked but they won't know who got it.

When everyone has picked their roles, the meeting will end and the game will start as normal.

[Information](#information) | [Settings](#settings)
---

sections.heading: Information
sections.text:
Escape the Facility is a gamemode similar to the game Dead By Daylight, or the roblox game Flee the Facility. 

There are two teams, the Fugitives & the Wardens. The Fugitives must escape the facility before the Wardens kill them all, or the timer runs out.

There are a certain amount of terminals per game depending on the amount of players in the lobby. The Fugitives must hack all of the terminals to unlock the exits.
There are a certain amount of exits per map (Warden Count + 1), these exits are only able to be hacked after all terminals are hacked.

There are three states to a terminal:
- Blue: Available to hack.
- Red: Previously Hacked but somebody failed a skill check, can still be hacked by pressing pet.
- Green: Already completed, cannot be hacked.

Throughout the game, you will see arrows on your name. This indicates two things:
- Red Arrow: A computer was failed, you can go to the arrow to find the failed computer.
- Blue Arrow: A player was captured, you can go to the arrow to save the person.

sections.heading: Fugitive Information
sections.text:
As a Fugitive, you need to hack terminals around the map using your pet button once. While hacking, there will be skill checks that will be indicated when you see a yellow terminal.. when the terminal turns purple, click the vanish button.

While hacking terminals, you will see a progress bar above your head. If you exit a terminal before it is finished, the progress will be saved for when you or someone else comes back to it.

When someone is captured by the beast, they will have a short period where they can be saved. To save a trapped fugitive, go to the vent which they are trapped in and vent in it. It should then let them out of the vent.
- If that player is trapped again then the timer will resume from where it was at previously.

After all terminals are hacked, you will have to find an exit around the map and open it to escape. If you see one exit, there is usually another one located on the exact opposite side of the map.
To open an exit, use your pet button once near it; it will then be unlocked for anyone to use. To go through the exit, just walk into it.

After escaping, you will spectate the game (you will appear as alive, but you are hidden from everyone).

sections.heading: Warden Information
sections.text:
As a Warden, your job is to trap and eliminate the Fugitives around the map before they can escape.
If you find a Fugitive, you can use your pet button on them to down them. While downed, they will walk slower for a short period. You can then use your kill button again to drag them. The warden can only drag one fugitive as a time.

While a Fugitive is being dragged, you can bring them to a vent and stand on it for a few seconds in order to trap them in that vent. While trapped, a timer will begin, and if the timer runs out, the Fugitive will die.

There is a variation of the Warden called the Runner, where you can use your Vanish button to gain a short speed boost.

sections.heading: Actions
sections.text:
__Long Hold Pet Button__: 

_Outside Crafting_: Brings you to the Crafting Menu

_Inside Crafting_: Close the Crafting Menu (also creates a potion if selected and all ingredients are collected)

_With Potion_: Use a crafted potion

__Pet Button__:

_Outside Crafting_: Picks up any ingredients in the area

_Inside Crafting_: Scrolls through potions

*Notes* 

> - Long Hold pet button long enough that you see the petting animation multiple times.

> - Short Hold pet button just long enough that you only see the petting animation one time.

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
Alchemist is a jack-of-all-trades Crewmate role that collects "ingredients". Ingredients can be found in the following ways:

  • Catalyst - Found by completing tasks

  • Essence of Sight - Found when helping fix lights

  • Fragment of Discussions - Found randomly in groups of 3 or more players

  • Shifting Rose - Found after a player shapeshifts

  • Theta Rift - Found randomly

  • Vital of Decay - Found off dead bodies

The Alchemist can use their pet button to pick up these ingredients, and will get a message below their name saying: "Found: [Ingredient Name]".

The Alchemist uses ingredients to craft potions, to switch into "crafting mode" the Alchemist must hold down their pet button. Once in crafting mode, the pet button can be used to switch the next crafted potion.

If in the crafting menu, the Alchemist can hold down their pet button to exit it. If the Alchemist has all the necessary ingredients to craft the potion they were on, the potion will begin crafting as they hold the pet button.

Once the Alchemist has a potion, they can hold down the pet button to use it, consuming it.

__*Red = Bad*__ 
 - __Impostors__ (always)
 - __Neutral Killing__ (predetermined by host)
 - __Neutral Passive__ (predetermined by host)
 - __Crewmate Killing__ (predetermined by host)
 - __Madmate__ (predetermined by host)
 
__*Green = Good*__ 
 - __Crewmates__ (always)

 - __Neutral Killing__ (predetermined by host)

 - __Neutral Passive__ (predetermined by host)

 - __Crewmate Killing__ (predetermined by host)

 - __Madmate__ (predetermined by host)

__Note:__ "(Faction) are red" main setting is by default **Off.**

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
The Jailor is a Crewmate role which by using their kill (or Pet) button on someone, can jail that person.

When someone is jailed, they cannot use any of their role's abilities (in meeting) or vote. Depending on the host's settings, they may also be visible to all during meetings.

> Even though the Jailed Player cannot vote, other players are unable to vote the Jailed Player as well. Depending on host's settings, the Jailed Player's vote may be able to be used by the Jailor.

The Jailor is also able to execute the Jailed Player by voting them in the meeting. Depending on options, if the Jailed Player was a Crewmate, the Jailor may suicide.

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
The Vigilante is a Crewmate that can kill Impostors and Neutrals by guessing the players and their roles. If the Vigilante is able to successfully guess a non-crewmate's role, then that player will be eliminated.

While in meeting, the Vigilante can select a player they want to guess by voting for them. They can then try to guess that player's role by using the /r [role] command (e.g. /r [Vampire](/roles/vampire)) in the chat. If the Vigilante correctly guesses both the player and their role, then that player will die. 

If the Vigilante misguesses, or tries to guess a Crewmate, they will suicide.

roles.title: Guesser
roles.summary: Modifier | Guess your opponents roles to eliminate them.
roles.credit: Idea By: Town of Us Reactivated | First seen in Lotus v1.1

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
Grants any role the ability to guess players' roles to eliminate them. If the Guesser is able to successfully guess a player's role, then that player will be eliminated.

While in meeting, the Guesser can select a player they want to guess by voting for them. They can then try to guess that player's role by using the /r [role] command (e.g. /r [Vampire](/roles/vampire)) in the chat.

If the Guesser correctly guesses both the player and their role, then that player will die. If the Guesser misguesses they will suicide. To skip guessing, you may skip first before voting for a player.

roles.title: Romantic
roles.summary: Modifier | Choose your romantic partner.
roles.credit: Original Role & Idea by Tealeaf/단풍잎 | First seen in Lotus v1.0

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
During the first meeting of the game, the Romantic MUST vote a player to become their partner (otherwise they'll die). Once a partner has been chosen, the Romantic can use their Pet Button to temporarily grant a shield to their partner.

If their partner dies, the Romantic will transform into either the **[Vengeful Romantic](/roles/vengeful-romantic)** or the **[Ruthless Romantic](/roles/ruthless-romantic)** depending on host's settings.

The Romantic may win with, or without their partner (only as a solo win) depending on the host's settings.

_Note: If 'Cancel Game Win if Solo Winner' is on, the Romantic can only win with their partners win condition. If both 'Partner Can Win With Romantic' and 'Cancel Game Win if Solo Winner' are off, then the Romantic can win **alone** with their role-base condition or their partner's._

_If there is more than one winner with the Romantic (e.g. Romantic is a Crewmate and Crewmates won) and their partner is not one of the winners, then the Romantic will be removed from the winner's list regardless of if 'Cancel Game Win if Solo Winner' is on or off (and 'Partner Can Win With Romantic' is off)._

sections.heading: Role Description
sections.text:
The Vengeful Romantic is assigned to players who had the **[Romantic](/roles/romantic)** modifier and their romantic partner was killed. Their goal is to now hunt down their partner's killer and to kill them. The Vengeful Romantic may use either their Pet Button or Kill Button (if they have one) to kill another player, but if they target an innocent player, the Vengeful Romantic will die from misfire. After successfully avenging their partner, the Vengeful Romantic regains its normal win with their base-role.

*Note: These options are found under the [Romantic's](/roles/romantic) settings when that modifier is turned on*
